subject: [PATCH v4 05/14] NFSD: report listener creation failures through extack

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the NFSD (Network File System Daemon) code to report listener creation failures through extack, providing more detailed error information to userland. Specifically, it records the attribute and transport name of the entry that failed and reports both after the loop, allowing for more precise identification of the issue. This change addresses a limitation where only generic error messages were provided, making it harder to diagnose specific problems.
